items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not Jack McVeigh. [INTERVIEWEE] Not McNea, but this guy did a lot of work with the recording studios.

ctx.x: And he made tracks, you know? And that's the reason it hit me first when I mention him, I said Bear Tracks, because you know -- and let's see, who else? We had a guy singing the blues called Blues Bailey and let me see, who else was in that band? Oh, tenor man that went on the West Coast there. What was his name? He was good. If I can think of his name.
Not McNea, but this guy did a lot of work with the recording studios.
